motivation: Read the complete official Neotoma chronology object structure, not string-match generic fields: chronologies contain reliableagespan, controls, default, modelType, geochron and calibration notes. Check exactly the original 21 candidate pollen-sample chronology assignments against the original source control-depth and reliability bounds.

methods.original_population_unit: datasetid + sampleid, NOT number of age models or controls
methods.candidate_inclusion: Exactly source original v18 positive pollen datum with labelled source calibrated radiocarbon years BP center between 18000 and24000 and explicit chronology ID, no new favourable sample selection.
methods.time_range: Use original source sample age at its explicitly assigned original chronologyid. Do not substitute other chronology even if it yields a more plausible date.
methods.official_model_metadata: chronology agetype, default, modelType, reliableagespan.younger/older, controls[].depth/age/controltype, source geochron and note fields, exact chronology->pollen dataset link.
methods.sample_controls: Compare source sample depth against MIN and MAX depths of all source-returned age controls. Below/above control depth => model age may be extrapolated; NOT automatically false date.
methods.model_reliability: If original age center outside source chronology reliableagespan younger/older => source chronology metadata fails center reliability. Inside => database-labelled reliability only, NOT independent calibrated chronology proof.
methods.control_bracketing: When source sample depth lies strictly between two separate controls, report ages and chronological gap; matching depth within limit is not age validation.
methods.age_uncertainty: Preserve original source ageyounger/ageolder and count missing bounds; do not borrow broad reliableagespan to replace per-sample uncertainty.
methods.alternative_model: Retain every age model's original source age for those 21 exact sampleIDs; report default age/type when present without choosing a preferred biological explanation.
methods.fossil_presence: Taxon ID 1299 and positive numeric pollen datum are not independently validated species-level local Alnus glutinosa occupancy.
methods.source_reproducibility: Exact SHA for every gzip chronology source body from original v19 receipt, no new live source requery during this QC.

outcomes: exact 11 chronology metadata and age-control schema records
exact 21 positive-labelled pollen-sample rows with source ages, source depth and source date bounds
source chronology age-type/default/reliable upper+lower, sample within/outside reliability flag
source sample depth inside/outside control depth bracket, neighboring dated age controls if present
alternative chronology age values for same original sample, independent age calibration status NOT VERIFIED
dataset-level descriptive counts, 0 accepted ancestral plant occupancy and 0 genetics
limits: These are post-retrieval exploratory quality diagnostics; do not frame them as preregistered confirmatory fossil hypothesis tests
An interpolated chronology estimate can be valid beyond the nearest available controls if a validated external model exists; this source metadata alone does not rule it out
Source `reliableagespan` is recorded database metadata; it is not independent verification of calibration, uncertainty, dated material or taphonomy
Even a well-dated positive genus-level pollen datum is not proof of local species-diagnostic living trees
Prior TTF v0.5 and chocho v0.8 other-real-plant host-specific climate nulls remain negative and unchanged
